DEF-460.title: Standalone Native adm without optional mtype is rendered but not identified as Native
DEF-460.expected: A standalone response carrying a Native1.2 assets body can be identified as Native without a request or optional OpenRTB2.6 mtype. Source placement intent (push) is kept separate from detectable Native carrier.
DEF-460.actual: Core, HTTP and browser return no format tags while the Inspector successfully classifies and renders the same Native creative.
notes: This is an omitted detection capability, not a normative IAB requirement for a particular application tag.
The exact new Native expectation was evaluated independently on all three layers; rendered identity remained asserted and passed.
